paite: Atung in Thu a-om a, Thu tuh Pathian kiang ah a-om, huai Thu Pathian ahi.
heading: Khrist Pathian Hihna

paite: Huai Thu mah atung in Pathian kiang ah a-om hi.
Bangkim avek in ama siam ahi; thilsiam tengteng amah siam louh bangmah a-om kei.
Amah ah hinna a-om, huai hinna mihingte vakna ahi.
Mial lak ah vak ahong vak a; mial in huai azou kei hi.
Pathian sawl mi khat a-om a, amin Johan ahi.
Huai mi theihpihtu hi ding in ahong, huai vak toh kisai theihpih ding in, amah tawn a mi tengteng in agintak theihna ding un.
Amah bel vak ahi kei a, vak thu theihpih ding a hong ahi zaw hi.
Vak diktak, michih kiang a vakna pia, khovel ah ahong pailel ahi.
Amah khovel ah a-om, khovel ama siam ahi, hinapi in khovel in amah athei kei hi.
Ama mite kiang ah ahong a, amite mahmah in ana pom kei uhi.
heading: Khrist Sa Hong Suahna

paite: Himahleh amah kipahpih a pom, amin gingtate tengteng kiang ah Pathian tate suahtheihna apia a:
amaute sisan hiam, sa deihna hiam, mihing deihna hiam hilou in, Pathian suan a piang ahi zaw uhi.
Huai Thu tuh sa ahong suak a, i lak uah ahong teng a, hehpihna leh thutak a dim in; athupina Pa Tapa tang neihsun thupina bangbang i muta uhi.
Johan in amah theihpihna apia a, "Ka nung a hong paipa'n hon paikheng, amah ka ma a omsa him ahih ziak in, chi a athu ka genpa hiai ahi," achi hi.
Huan eite'n ataangchinna a kipan hehpihna tung a hehpih nawnsawnna i tang chiat uhi.
Mosi zang a Dan piak ahi a, himahleh Jesu Khrist ziak in hehpihna leh thutak ahong om hi.
Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei; Tapa tang neihsun, Pa angsung a om in theihtheih in amah abawlta hi.
Huan Judate'n, "Kua na hia?" chi a dong ding a, Jerusalem a kipan akiang a siampute leh Levi chi a mite asawl lai un hiaite Johan thu na theihsak ahi uhi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Thupuak / (Mat 3.1-12; Mar 1.1-8; Luk 3.1-18)

paite: Ama'n chiangtak in agen a, "Khrist ka hi kei hi," chi in apulak hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Kua na hia le? Elijah na hi hia?" achi ua, adong uhi. Huan ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. "Huai zawlnei na hi hia?" achi ua. Ama'n, "Hilou e,” chi in adawng hi.
Amau akiang ah ahihleh, "Kua na hia? Hon sawlte ka dawntheihna ding un hon hilh in; na tanchin himhim bang ahia na gen ding?" achi uhi.
Ama'n, zawlnei Isai gen bang in, "Toupa lampi hihtang un, chi a, gamdai a kikoupa aw ka hi," achi hi.
Amisawlte uh Pharisaite kiang a kipan kuate hiam ahi uhi.
Amau akiang ah, "Khrist bek, Elijah bek, zawlnei bek na hih kei ngalleh bang achia baptis nak na hia le?" achi ua, adong nawn uhi.
Johan in akiang uah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, na lak uah mi khat na theih louh uh adingh ahi,
mah ahi ka nung a hong pai dingpa, ka ma a omsa pen, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei," chi in adawng hi.
Hiaite Jordan gal a Bethani a Johan in abaptisna mun a thil tung ahi.
Huan azing in Johan in akiang a hong pai Jesu amu a, agen a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou khovel khelhna lamangpa!
heading: Pathian Belamnou

paite: Hiai ahi amah, mi khat ka nung a hong paipa, ka ma a omsa him ahi, ka chihpa.
Amah lah ka na thei ngal kei a; himahleh Israelte kiang a amah latsak ahihna ding in tui a baptis in ka hong pai ahi,” achi hi.
Huan Johan in athu atheisak a, "Vakhu bang in van a kipan Kha hong suk ka mu a, atung ah a-om nilouh," chi in agen hi.
Amah lah ka thei ngal kei a; himahleh tui a baptis ding a hon sawlpa'n ka kiang ah, "Kua tung ah leng Kha hong suk a atung a om na muh peuh, hiai tuh Kha Siangthou a baptispa ahi, ahon chi hi.
Huai ka muta a, hiai mipa Pathian Tapa ahi chih ka theisakta hi,” achi hi.
Huan azing nawn in anungzui nihte toh Johan adingh a,
heading: Jesu Nungzui Masate

paite: Jesu vialvak vak lai a-en a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou!" achi hi.
Anungzui nihte'n athugen aza ua, Jesu azuita uhi.
Jesu akihei a, ahon zui uh amu a, akiang uah, "Bang ahia na zon uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Rabbi (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi), koi a teng na hia?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hong le uchin na mu ding uh," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai ua, a-omna amu ua; huai hun dak sawmna vel ahih tak ziak in akiang ah huai ni ataam uhi.
Johan thugen za a Jesu zui nihte lak a khat zaw pen Andru, Simon Peter sanggampa ahi.
Ama'n amasapen in amah sanggampa Simon amu a, akiang ah, "Messia ka muta uh," achi a, huai tuh Khrist chihna ahi.
Huchi in Jesu'n amah ana en a, "Johan tapa Simon na hi, Kifas ahon chi ding uh," achi a (huai tuh Peter chihna hi).
Huan azing in Jesu'n Galili gam a hoh atum a, Philip amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
heading: Philip leh Nathanael Sapna

paite: Philip bel Bethsaida khomi ahi a, Andru leh Peter omna khopi mah ahi.
Philip in Nathanael amu a, akiang ah, atanchin Mosi in dan laibu a agelh leh zawlneite'n agelh uh, "Amah ka muta uhi, Nazaret Jesu, Joseph tapa," achi hi.
Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nazaret ah thil hoih apawt thei a hia?" achi hi. Philip in akiang ah, "Hong pai inla, en in," achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang a Nathanael hong dek in amu a, atanchin ana gen a, "En un, Israel mitak, khemna himhim nei lou," achi hi.
Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nang bangchidan a hon thei na hia?" achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip in nang ahon sap ma a, theipi bul a na om lai in, ka hon mu hi," chi in adawng hi.
Nathanael in akiang ah, "Rabbi, Pathian Tapa na hi, Israelte kumpipa na hi," chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Theipi bul ah nang ka hon mu, na kiang a ka chih ziak in na gingta ahi maw? Hiaite sang a thil thupizaw na mu lai ding," chi in adawng hi.
Huan Jesu mah in akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, van kihong a, Mihing Tapa tung a Pathian angelte kahtou leh kumsuk na mu ding uh," achi hi.
